The '''sun'''<ref name="LOTF:E">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref> of the [[Ziost system/Legends|Ziost system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> was located up north within the [[Stygian Caldera]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It constituted a part of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]<ref name="OuterRim" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Star/Legends|star]] was situated along the [[Nache Bhelfia]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA" /> and was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]], albeit distantly, by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]<ref name="TOR:A" /> as well as its two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="The End of It All" />

During a [[mission to Ziost]]<ref name="TOR:A" /> in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' to [[3640 BBY]].</ref> in the afternoon the star appeared a faded orange [[Color/Legends|color]] from the surface as the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] was dry and gritty with tiny particles of dirt and dust swept along by the breeze.<ref name="TOR:A" /> Shortly before the [[Invasion of Ziost]], the sun was a bright blue color, but appeared white from the surface.<ref name="A Presence on Ziost">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|A Presence on Ziost|Ziost}}</ref> Due to the effects of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate's]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|Force ritual]] following the invasion<ref name="The End of It All" /> in [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.2}}</ref> the color of the star changed to greenish-yellow, though it appeared to be a pale brown from the surface of Ziost.<ref name="The End of It All" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Once the sun was up high enough to provide some sparse heat to his surroundings, he and Shaker set out again. He could still feel the distant glee.|Ben Skywalker thinks about Ziost's sun|<ref name="LOTF:E" />}}
Ziost's sun first appeared in the [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[2007]] novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]'', the fourth volume of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series.<ref name="LOTF:E" /> It was first pictured in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion as part of the Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor that introduced the planet Ziost to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="A Presence on Ziost" /> Although the Ziost system, and therefore its sun, was listed as being located in grid square R-5 in the Appendix section of ''The Essential Atlas'', the book's map of the Sith Worlds placed it within square R-4,<ref name="TEA" /> which was repeated in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book.<ref name="EAOC" /> This article assumes the book's Appendix section is erroneous and that R-4 is the correct square.
